title: Localize focus choice diagnostics
changes: Use English source messages and the existing English and Italian catalogs for tool and content-selector choice instructions in focus diagnostics, without changing selection identifiers or geometry.
validation: Offline isolated Linux menu test choice_focus_diagnostics_follow_menu_language passed for both screens and languages; scripts/menu_language.py check passed with 635 entries in each catalog; git diff --check passed.
limitations: First Linux build lacked Wayland pkg-config metadata; the passing build used temporary metadata with the installed runtime. The first test exposed locked test setup and passed after unlocking it. Native Windows and live GUI were not tested.
